artworks.title: Bridge at Caracas
artworks.medium: transparent watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: overall: 24 x 30.5 cm (9 7/16 x 12 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting shows an arched stone bridge spanning across a rocky green divide. Our perspective is low, and we look up at the bridge, seeing the people who cross it silhouetted against the pale sky and distant blue hills. A palm tree stands tall on the left side of the bridge, above a white building. On the right appears to be a large gray wall or fortress. Closer to us at the bottom of the scene, two small people are visible standing near the base of the bridge, between the green walls on either side. The brushstrokes are loose, giving an impressionistic feel to the landscape, with few details visible in the people or the structures. The color palette is warm and earthy, dominated by various shades of brown, ochre, and green blending softly.

artworks.title: Factory on the Oise at Pontoise
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper mounted on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: Parisian Omnibus
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a painting of a horse-drawn carriage with a driver and luggage on top. The painting features a horse-drawn carriage moving across a watercolor landscape. The carriage is drawn by a team of horses towards the left of the composition, with its wheels painted in large strokes suggesting motion. On top, there is a pile of luggage or goods. The painting is in the style of Maurice Prendergast, known for his use of watercolors and semi-abstract forms depicting lively scenes.

artworks.title: Figures on a Beach
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered by a body of water. The individuals are dressed in 19th-century attire, with one person holding a red parasol. Sailboats can be seen in the distance on the water. The scene has loose and fluid brushstrokes, predominantly in soft shades of blue and gray. The sky is filled with clouds depicted with horizontal strokes.

artworks.title: Revere Beach
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The painting shows the view of a seashore. Groups of people are gathered on the rocky outcrop along the water's edge, some standing and some sitting. Many of the people seem to be wearing dresses and holding parasols. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, and the people are depicted in loose sections of color, including white, pink, blue, gray, and brown. Distant sailboats can be seen on the horizon on the left. The sky is depicted with broad blue swathes and hints of off-white clouds, and the rocky shore is depicted in shades of brown and gray.

artworks.title: Five Butterflies
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting shows five butterflies of various colors on a cream-colored background. The butterflies are arranged in a loose diagonal line, although four of them are gathered closer to the top-right corner. The butterflies are painted in colors such as blue, red, yellow, and brown. The butterflies are painted with varying levels of detail, with one in the center being particularly abstract. The lowest butterfly, near the bottom-left corner, appears to be crawling or is seen from a side view, while the other four are flying and are seen from above.

artworks.title: Four Peonies and a Crown Imperial
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on parchment mounted on board
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: The Square
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on thin brown wove paper, laid down on cream paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a garden area from a slightly elevated perspective, with a structured setting beyond. The horizon is not clearly defined, leading to a distant building that acts as the scene's boundary. Black ink brushstrokes create loose and expressive foliage and architectural details. The color palette is minimal, with tan paper and dark ink outlining trees, shrubs, pathways, and the distant building. The focus is on light, shadow, shapes, and the suggestion of details rather than precise representations.

artworks.title: Lanius rufus
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds perched on a branch. The painting illustrates two birds with reddish-brown heads, black wings with white markings, and light-colored underparts. They are situated on a brown branch that has a couple of green leaves sprouting from it. The background is left plain, emphasizing the detailed depiction of the birds and the branch. The word "Lanius Rufus" is inscribed at the top of the image.

artworks.title: Sitta europea
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two birds perched on branches. The artwork features two birds with distinct markings and colors, perched on a pair of intertwined branches with several green leaves. The birds have dark upper parts and lighter underparts with a sleek appearance. The branches are rendered in a delicate, detailed manner, curving elegantly across the page. The leaves add a touch of natural green, contrasting with the light background. The title "SITTA EUROPEA" is inscribed at the top.

artworks.title: Baltimore Taken near Whetstone Point
artworks.medium: hand-colored aquatint with touches of engraving  on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 51 x 68.6 cm (20 1/16 x 27 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of a landscape with a cityscape in the distance across water, sailboats, cows grazing, two people seated, a large tree with autumn foliage, and detailed brushstrokes depicting a harmonious color palette of earthy and soft tones.

artworks.title: Baltimore from Federal Hill
artworks.medium: color aquatint with touches of etching, hand-colored, on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 53.2 x 67.2 cm (20 15/16 x 26 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a busy harbor with a cityscape surrounding a river or bay. The horizon line is elevated, meeting the sky at the rooftops of the city in the distance, with tall ship masts and industrial structures visible. Buildings on the horizon create an urban skyline with steeples and chimneys. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing human and natural elements. Near the foreground, a grassy hill has people and animals engaged in various activities. The color palette includes soft earthy tones for the land and structures, contrasting with pale blues and greys for the water and sky.

artworks.title: Boston: From City Point near Sea Street
artworks.medium: color aquatint with touches of etching, hand-colored, on wove paper; laid down on heavy wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 48.8 x 68.2 cm (19 3/16 x 26 7/8 in.)
support: 53.2 x 72.8 cm (20 15/16 x 28 11/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image depicts a harbor scene with people and boats on calm water. The cityscape and a windmill are visible in the background. The scene is painted with fine brushstrokes capturing details of sails, boats, and reflections. The color palette is soft with shades of blue, brown, and beige dominating. In the distance, a larger sailboat and city buildings are visible against swirling clouds. The atmosphere is tranquil and peaceful.

artworks.title: Boston: From the Ship House West End of the Navy Yard
artworks.medium: color aquatint with touches of engraving, hand-colored, on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with boats of various sizes sailing on calm waters. On the right side, a large three-masted ship sails, and a small rowboat with four people is in the center. To the left, sailboats are docked near a wooden jetty, and a large warehouse is visible. In the background, a town with church steeples and chimney stacks can be seen. The sky occupies half of the image, with soft clouds in subtle brushstrokes. The color palette includes muted blues, grays, and earthy tones.

artworks.title: Buffalo, from Lake Erie
artworks.artist: William James Bennett after John William Hill
artworks.medium: hand-colored aquatint with touches of engraving  on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a view of Lake Erie with a harbor scene. Multiple boats, including a steamship and sailboats, are visible on the water. People are on the vessels. In the distance, there is a city skyline with various buildings and steeples. A tall lighthouse with a red dome is prominent on the right side. The sky has swirling clouds painted with broad brushstrokes, creating a sense of movement. The color palette is muted, with soft blues and grays for the sky and water, and earthy tones for the buildings.

artworks.title: City of Detroit, Michigan: Taken from the Canada Shore near the Ferry
artworks.artist: William James Bennett after Frederick K. Grain
artworks.medium: hand-colored aquatint with touches of engraving  on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 53.2 x 72.9 cm (20 15/16 x 28 11/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: City of Washington: From beyond the Navy Yards
artworks.artist: William James Bennett after George Cooke
artworks.medium: hand-colored aquatint with touches of engraving  on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 53.6 x 70 cm (21 1/8 x 27 9/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view looking down at a city. In the upper third, there are distant hills and a cloudy sky. The landscape includes a dirt path with some boulders, an ox-drawn cart, a river with sailboats, fields, and city buildings in the background. The colors mainly consist of earthy tones for the land and soft blues and grays for the sky and water, creating a balanced composition.

artworks.title: New Orleans: Taken from the Opposite Side, a Short Distance above the Middle or Picayyune Ferry
artworks.artist: William James Bennett after Antoine Mondelli
artworks.medium: color aquatint with touches of engraving, hand-colored, on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 52.3 x 68 cm (20 9/16 x 26 3/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image depicts a harbor scene with ships, people, and buildings. The composition shows a river with city buildings in the background against a sky with clouds. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the ships, people, and activities. The color palette includes blues, greys, browns, greens, whites, and tans. A church spire and domed building can be seen on the horizon in the urban landscape. The scene conveys a sense of bustling maritime trade and daily life.

artworks.title: Niagara Falls from the American Side
artworks.artist: William James Bennett after John Robert Murray
artworks.medium: hand-colored aquatint with touches of engraving
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 51.8 x 64.8 cm (20 3/8 x 25 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of Niagara Falls from the American side. The horizon is low, obscured by the waterfalls dominating the scene. The artwork depicts the water, rocks, cliffs, and trees with detailed precision. Earthy tones like grays and browns are used for rocks and cliffs, while soft blues and whites represent the water and mist. Mist rises from the falls where they crash into the river. A small boat with a few people is visible on the water.

artworks.title: Niagara Falls from the Table Rock
artworks.medium: hand-colored aquatint
artworks.dimensions:
image: 40.8 × 58.5 cm (16 1/16 × 23 1/16 in.)
sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 52.3 × 65.2 cm (20 9/16 × 25 11/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows Niagara Falls seen from Table Rock. The falls dominate the scene, with a strip of greenery and trees marking the horizon. The water is portrayed using fine brushstrokes to depict movement and texture. The color scheme includes blues, greens, and earth tones. Near the viewer, there are coniferous trees and a man with a dog observing the falls. In the distance, the landscape fades into mist.

artworks.title: Niagara Falls from Foot of Staircase
artworks.artist: John Hill, after William James Bennett
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 59 x 46.9 cm (23 1/4 x 18 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall flowing down rocks into mist. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing the horizon, undulating landscapes, sky, and clouds. The waterfall is depicted with fine brushstrokes, conveying movement. Trees and vegetation are textured with varied strokes. The color palette includes browns, greens, whites, blues, grays, and a few figures with a dog on the rocky terrain.

artworks.title: Niagara Falls from Under Table Rock
artworks.artist: John Hill, after William James Bennett
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 58.4 x 45.1 cm (23 x 17 3/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall, likely part of Niagara Falls, with a title at the bottom. The viewpoint is from below and to the side, showcasing the rock face where the water flows down from the cliffs on the right. The waterfall creates a stream of white and blue hues. At the top of the rock face, a lone figure overlooks the falls. The sky is filled with textured clouds, blending soft brushstrokes. The color palette includes earth tones, greens, and pale blues and whites. Figures are also visible on the rocks, with some gesturing towards the falls.

artworks.title: Richmond: From the Hill above the Waterworks
artworks.artist: William James Bennett after George Cooke
artworks.medium: hand-colored aquatint
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 54 x 68.8 cm (21 1/4 x 27 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape from an elevated viewpoint overlooking a rolling terrain descending to a river. There are buildings in the urban area on the horizon, lush greenery and people sitting on the grass to the right, and grazing animals to the left. A river winds through the scene, with a mix of cityscape, trees, and water in the distance. The artwork features detailed brushwork and a vibrant yet harmonious color palette.

artworks.title: Troy: Taken from the West Bank of the Hudson in front of the United States Arsenal
artworks.medium: hand-colored aquatint with touches of engraving  on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 49.5 x 70.7 cm (19 1/2 x 27 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor with various sailing vessels and a steam-powered boat. A town is visible across the water. The horizon is positioned approximately one-third from the top, separating the sky from the distant hills and town structures. A tree frames the left side, and small groups of people are engaged in various activities along the shore. The brushwork is precise and clear, resembling detailed engravings or lithographs. The color palette consists of soft pastels, with light blues for the sky and water, earthy browns for the shore and trees, and gentle greens for the foliage and hills, creating a harmonious visual effect.
